composition.structure: Strict modular grid with one oversized KPI anchor
composition.alignment: Left aligned text with chart baselines locked to a shared grid
composition.whitespace: High between modules, compact within data groups
composition.density: Medium information density with low decorative density
composition.focal_points: Primary KPI first, trend line second, supporting cards third
composition.spatial_rhythm: Consistent 8/16/32 spacing rhythm creates disciplined pacing

color.strategy: Soft grey canvas + near-black type + one cobalt signal color

typography.headline: Large neo-grotesk numerals; compact and technical
typography.hierarchy: Scale and weight, not decoration, create hierarchy
typography.alignment: Left aligned with numeric columns visually aligned

texture.image_treatment: Charts use crisp strokes and restrained labels

mood.label: Analytical
mood.because: strict grid + aligned numerals + low decoration

mood.label: Calm
mood.because: wide module spacing prevents dashboard compression

mood.label: Modern
mood.because: neutral surfaces + one functional signal color

why_it_works: The dashboard looks disciplined because every visual choice supports comparison. Large numbers create a fast entry point, repeated alignment makes scanning effortless, and the single cobalt accent is reserved for information that deserves attention.
